_why.day.FRAME_DX_KM: 6 km west centres Greater London; Uxbridge and Heathrow leave the tall-phone crop
_why.week.FRAME_DX_KM: 6 km west centres Greater London; Uxbridge and Heathrow leave the tall-phone crop

_why.week.FRAME_DY_KM: 6 km south puts the Tube centre mid-band and clears the subtitle; the south tip stays above the clock
_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 1.6 px dots read as trains like the target; at 1.2 they sink into the 3 px lines and the Tube reads as streaks
_why.BASE_ROADS_GAIN: 0.75 quiets the dense London road grid so the thin District and Piccadilly lines stand off it

_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 lingers a few minutes longer on the peaks, unseen, and brings strobe to 0.00399, under the limit
_why.rush.FRAME_ZOOM: 0.9 lifts Edgware and Cockfosters off the subtitle and pulls the Epping end off the buttons; the core still fills
_why.rush.BUS_CORE_R: 1.6 px dots cut close-up strobe from 0.0068 to 0.0042 and match the day's dots
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: 21 min gets close-up strobe to 0.00392; colours stay distinct and dots read, no white fusing

groups.label: Northern
